correctness.rationale: At a smooth torus fixed point the Seshadri constant is the minimum primitive lattice length of incident polytope edges, by the blowup-invariant-curve nef criterion. Under Loday leaf-product vertex coordinates, rotation ((AB)C)↔(A(BC)) changes exactly two inorder coordinates by ac(e_i−e_j), so each length is ac. A deepest cherry has sibling leaf/cherry and yields ac≤2. Length-one rotations are exactly the specified local avoidance; if A counts good internal-root trees with left leaf then A=z(G−A), and G=1+zG²−2zA, giving the claimed algebraic equation. Independent enumeration of all Catalan tree shapes n≤9 matches counts; finite evidence is not the all-n proof. Ito’s generalized permutohedron width theorem plus interval-cut width n−1 establishes the separate dense-torus value under precise unit lattice normalization.
